key: LIN: So one makes it after all.
en: LIN: So one makes it after all.
ja: リン: それで、一人はたどり着いたわけね。

key: Through mountain and molehill,
en: Through mountain and molehill,
ja: 山を越え、塚を越え、

key: You persevere as predictably as ever.
en: You persevere as predictably as ever.
ja: 相変わらず、予想通りに耐え抜いた。

key: Now that you're here, we've no need for words,
en: Now that you're here, we've no need for words,
ja: もうここまで来たなら、言葉は要らないでしょう、

key: Do we?
en: Do we?
ja: そうでしょう?

key: The others have kept you long enough.
en: The others have kept you long enough.
ja: 他の者たちが、あなたを十分に引き留めたはず。

key: What needed to be finished, has been.
en: What needed to be finished, has been.
ja: 終えるべきことは、もう終わっている。

key: The final PULSE machine...
en: The final PULSE machine...
ja: 最後のPULSEマシン……

key: That which will open the way to the new world.
en: That which will open the way to the new world.
ja: 新たな世界への道を開くもの。

key: You may see for yourself, or fail trying.
en: You may see for yourself, or fail trying.
ja: 自分の目で確かめるか、それに失敗するか、好きにすればいい。

key: Before you sleep, creature, you have one more task.
en: Before you sleep, creature, you have one more task.
ja: 眠りにつく前に　もうひとつ　やることがありますよ　哀れな生き物

key: LIN: Do not relish in your victory too soon.
en: LIN: Do not relish in your victory too soon.
ja: リン: 勝利にあまり早く酔いしれないことね。

key: You are not afforded the privilege of the usual success.
en: You are not afforded the privilege of the usual success.
ja: あなたには、いつもの成功という特権は与えられていない。

key: This creature was created not to fight, but to obey.
en: This creature was created not to fight, but to obey.
ja: この生き物は、戦うためではなく、従うために作られた。

key: LIN: Abra.
en: LIN: Abra.
ja: リン: ケーシィ。

key: Take us there.
en: Take us there.
ja: 私たちをそこへ連れて行きなさい。

key: FLORA: Finally...
en: FLORA: Finally...
ja: フローラ: やっと……

key: This has only been a gigantic pain in my ass.
en: This has only been a gigantic pain in my ass.
ja: ここまで、ただの巨大な面倒でしかなかったわ。

key: Look, this is going to take a while.
en: Look, this is going to take a while.
ja: ねえ、これには少し時間がかかるわよ。

key: I'm confident this is all I need, so you can go.
en: I'm confident this is all I need, so you can go.
ja: 必要なのはこれで全部だと思うから、あんたはもう行っていいわよ。

key: First, I'm getting my data, and second, I'm releasing this poor Abra ASAP.
en: First, I'm getting my data, and second, I'm releasing this poor Abra ASAP.
ja: まず、あたしはデータを取って、次に、このかわいそうなケーシィをできるだけ早く解放する。

key: I can't believe it was just hooked up to this thing and left here...
en: I can't believe it was just hooked up to this thing and left here...
ja: これがただこの機械につながれて、放置されてただけだったなんて信じられない……

key: Whoever did this must've been beyond rotten.
en: Whoever did this must've been beyond rotten.
ja: これをやった奴、相当腐ってたに違いないわ。

key: And if it's in the Champion room...
en: And if it's in the Champion room...
ja: それに、チャンピオンの部屋にあったってことは……

key: I suppose you already dealt with them, huh.
en: I suppose you already dealt with them, huh.
ja: もう連中には対処済みなんでしょうね。

key: Well, you get some points from me for that.
en: Well, you get some points from me for that.
ja: まあ、それに関してはあんたにポイントあげるわ。

key: Anyway, this won't be quick.
en: Anyway, this won't be quick.
ja: とにかく、これはすぐには終わらないから。

key: You can go do... whatever it is Champions do in these places.
en: You can go do... whatever it is Champions do in these places.
ja: あんたはこういうとこでチャンピオンがやることをやってきなさいよ……何であれ。

key: There's a room further back, isn't there?
en: There's a room further back, isn't there?
ja: この奥にもう一部屋あるんじゃないの?

key: I'll meet you at Eve's house later once I'm done.
en: I'll meet you at Eve's house later once I'm done.
ja: 終わったら、後でイヴの家で会いましょう。

key: FLORA: This won't be quick.
en: FLORA: This won't be quick.
ja: フローラ: これはすぐには終わらないわ。

key: WELCOME TO THE REBORN LEAGUE HALL OF FAME
en: WELCOME TO THE REBORN LEAGUE HALL OF FAME
ja: リボーンリーグ殿堂入りへようこそ

key: Registering .
en: Registering .
ja: 登録中 .

key: Registering . .
en: Registering . .
ja: 登録中 . .

key: Registering . . .
en: Registering . . .
ja: 登録中 . . .

key: TAKA: So, this is the Champion chamber then, huh?
en: TAKA: So, this is the Champion chamber then, huh?
ja: タカ: つまり、ここがチャンピオンの部屋ってことか。

key: It's pretty dull compared to the Elite Four rooms, don't you think?
en: It's pretty dull compared to the Elite Four rooms, don't you think?
ja: 四天王の部屋に比べると、結構地味だと思わない?

key: ???: I couldn't agree more!
en: ???: I couldn't agree more!
ja: ???: 全くその通り!

key: ELENA?: Taka, \PN.
en: ELENA?: Taka, \PN.
ja: エレナ?: タカ、\PN。

key: It's great to see you both again.
en: It's great to see you both again.
ja: また会えてうれしいわ。

key: TAKA: Wait, Elena!?
en: TAKA: Wait, Elena!?
ja: タカ: 待って、エレナ!?

key: Celebi, did you take us backwards again?
en: Celebi, did you take us backwards again?
ja: セレビィ、また過去に戻したのか?

key: I thought we were finally back home...
en: I thought we were finally back home...
ja: やっと現在に戻れたと思ったのに……

key: NOT ELENA: Elena?
en: NOT ELENA: Elena?
ja: エレナじゃない人: エレナ?

key: Oh, duh.
en: Oh, duh.
ja: ああ、そっか。

key: Luck would certainly lead you to her on a journey through time.
en: Luck would certainly lead you to her on a journey through time.
ja: 時を渡る旅なら、運命があんたをエレナに導いても不思議じゃないもんね。

key: I never met her myself but...
en: I never met her myself but...
ja: 直接会ったことはないけど……

key: I hope she was nice.
en: I hope she was nice.
ja: いい人だったといいな。

key: Dad never really spoke about her...
en: Dad never really spoke about her...
ja: パパはあの人のこと、ほとんど話してくれなかったから……

key: TAKA: Dad...
en: TAKA: Dad...
ja: タカ: パパって……

key: Wait, Heather?
en: Wait, Heather?
ja: 待って、ヘザー?

key: You look just like her--
en: You look just like her--
ja: エレナにそっくりだから――

key: I'm sorry, I--
en: I'm sorry, I--
ja: ごめん、俺――

key: HEATHER: No, don't apologize.
en: HEATHER: No, don't apologize.
ja: ヘザー: いや、謝んなくていいよ。

key: It's...
en: It's...
ja: これは……

key: I'm just glad you both finally showed up.
en: I'm just glad you both finally showed up.
ja: 二人ともやっと現れてくれて、ただうれしいだけだから。

key: You both just disappeared one day.
en: You both just disappeared one day.
ja: 二人とも、ある日突然消えちゃったんだよね。

key: Until she figured out it was Celebi, nobody had any idea where you went.
en: Until she figured out it was Celebi, nobody had any idea where you went.
ja: 彼女がセレビィのことだって突き止めるまで、誰も二人がどこに行ったのか全然わかんなかったんだ。

key: Everyone was pretty bummed out.
en: Everyone was pretty bummed out.
ja: みんなすっごく落ち込んでたよ。

key: TAKA: I'm not surprised, with \PN vanishing.
en: TAKA: I'm not surprised, with \PN vanishing.
ja: タカ: だろうな、\PNが消えちゃったんじゃ。

key: HEATHER: With BOTH of you vanishing.
en: HEATHER: With BOTH of you vanishing.
ja: ヘザー: 二人ともいなくなったから、だよ。

key: People were just as sad that you were gone too, Taka.
en: People were just as sad that you were gone too, Taka.
ja: タカ、あんたがいなくなったことも、みんな同じくらい悲しんでたし。

key: TAKA: That's...
en: TAKA: That's...
ja: タカ: それは……

key: Wait, you mentioned 'she'?
en: Wait, you mentioned 'she'?
ja: 待って、今「彼女」って言った?

key: Who are you talking about?
en: Who are you talking about?
ja: 誰のこと言ってるんだ?

key: HEATHER: Heh.
en: HEATHER: Heh.
ja: ヘザー: へへ。

key: The Champion, of course!
en: The Champion, of course!
ja: チャンピオンのことに決まってるじゃん!

key: You don't think we'd just go ten years without someone claiming the title, do you?
en: You don't think we'd just go ten years without someone claiming the title, do you?
ja: 十年もの間、誰もその座に就かないなんてあり得ないでしょ?

key: She was the one that figured out you found Celebi and were traveling through time.
en: She was the one that figured out you found Celebi and were traveling through time.
ja: あんたたちがセレビィを見つけて、時間旅行してるって突き止めたのも、彼女なんだ。

key: A lot of people lost faith but...
en: A lot of people lost faith but...
ja: 結構みんな諦めかけてたけど……

key: She was certain you'd both come back.
en: She was certain you'd both come back.
ja: 彼女は、二人が絶対に戻ってくるって確信してた。

key: Not that she didn't stack the deck in our favor.
en: Not that she didn't stack the deck in our favor.
ja: もっとも、彼女、あたしたちに有利になるよう仕込んでなかったわけじゃないけど。

key: She knew Celebi would come looking for the Relic Stone, so she went to the New World and got it back herself.
en: She knew Celebi would come looking for the Relic Stone, so she went to the New World and got it back herself.
ja: セレビィが遺跡の石を探しに来るってわかってたから、彼女自ら新世界に行って、それを取り戻したんだよ。

key: That way, Celebi would hopefully bring you to us.
en: That way, Celebi would hopefully bring you to us.
ja: そうすれば、セレビィがあんたたちをここに連れてきてくれるかもしれないって思って。

key: And here we are...
en: And here we are...
ja: それで、今こうしてる、と。

key: TAKA: So... I mean, who is it?
en: TAKA: So... I mean, who is it?
ja: タカ: それって……つまり、誰なんだ?

key: Who's the Champion now?
en: Who's the Champion now?
ja: 今のチャンピオンって?

key: HEATHER: ...You'll see.
en: HEATHER: ...You'll see.
ja: ヘザー: ……見ればわかるよ。

key: First time in Reborn's history that a Gym Leader has challenged the Pokémon League--
en: First time in Reborn's history that a Gym Leader has challenged the Pokémon League--
ja: リボーン史上初めて、ジムリーダーがポケモンリーグに挑戦して――

key: And won on her first try, no less!
en: And won on her first try, no less!
ja: しかも一発目で勝っちゃったんだから、すごいよね!

key: But I shouldn't keep you, she's waiting.
en: But I shouldn't keep you, she's waiting.
ja: でも、あんたたちを引き止めちゃダメだね、彼女が待ってるから。

key: She wanted a fancy room like we Elite Four get, so we just turned this into an entranceway.
en: She wanted a fancy room like we Elite Four get, so we just turned this into an entranceway.
ja: あたしたち四天王みたいな豪華な部屋がほしいって彼女が言うから、ここは入口用に作り替えたんだ。

key: Seriously, for a champion room, this was so underwhelming.
en: Seriously, for a champion room, this was so underwhelming.
ja: マジで、チャンピオンの部屋にしてはしょぼすぎたし。

key: Anyway, head through the door in back to get to her room.
en: Anyway, head through the door in back to get to her room.
ja: とにかく、奥のドアを通れば彼女の部屋に行けるから。

key: And... I'll see you guys later.
en: And... I'll see you guys later.
ja: それじゃ……また後でね。

key: Or, I guess, earlier?
en: Or, I guess, earlier?
ja: って言うか、前でって言うべき?

key: Time travel is confusing.
en: Time travel is confusing.
ja: 時間旅行ってほんとややこしい。

key: TAKA: Ten years in the future...
en: TAKA: Ten years in the future...
ja: タカ: 十年後の未来か……

key: Do you think she meant it?
en: Do you think she meant it?
ja: 彼女、あれ本気で言ってたと思う?

key: That people were sad that...
en: That people were sad that...
ja: みんな悲しんでたって……

key: That people noticed I was gone?
en: That people noticed I was gone?
ja: 俺がいなくなったことに、みんな気づいてたって?

key: ...Come on, Celebi.
en: ...Come on, Celebi.
ja: ……行こう、セレビィ。

key: Let's go meet the Champion, I guess.
en: Let's go meet the Champion, I guess.
ja: チャンピオンに会いに行くとしようか。

key: ELIAS: Back at last, it seems.
en: ELIAS: Back at last, it seems.
ja: イライアス: ようやく戻ってきたようですね。

key: I must say, though, such a simple chamber is not befitting of you, my Lord.
en: I must say, though, such a simple chamber is not befitting of you, my Lord.
ja: しかし、これほど質素な部屋は、我が主にふさわしいとは言えません。

key: As Champion, I feel you should have a room at least as impressive as the Elite Four.
en: As Champion, I feel you should have a room at least as impressive as the Elite Four.
ja: チャンピオンとして、少なくとも四天王と同じくらい立派な部屋を持つべきだと思います。

key: ELENA?: El, \PN.
en: ELENA?: El, \PN.
ja: エレナ?: エル、\PN。

key: It's been a while.
en: It's been a while.
ja: 久しぶりね。

key: ELIAS: Oh dear, did we go back in time again for some reason?
en: ELIAS: Oh dear, did we go back in time again for some reason?
ja: イライアス: おや、また何かの理由で過去に戻ってしまったのでしょうか?
わたし——

key: Wait, you look a little different...
en: Wait, you look a little different...
ja: 待ってください、少し様子が違いますね……

key: NOT ELENA: No shit, old man.
en: NOT ELENA: No shit, old man.
ja: エレナじゃない人: あったり前じゃん、おじいちゃん。

key: I'm not a kid anymore.
en: I'm not a kid anymore.
ja: あたしもう子供じゃないから。

key: You've been gone 10 years.
en: You've been gone 10 years.
ja: あんたが消えて10年経つんだよ。

key: ELIAS: That doesn't--
en: ELIAS: That doesn't--
ja: イライアス: それは――

key: Oh.
en: Oh.
ja: そう

key: Heather, hello.
en: Heather, hello.
ja: ヘザー、こんにちは。

key: My apologies, I thought you were--
en: My apologies, I thought you were--
ja: 失礼しました、あなたを――

key: I'm sorry, did you just say 10 years?
en: I'm sorry, did you just say 10 years?
ja: すみません、今、10年とおっしゃいましたか?

key: HEATHER: Yeah, we were the Elite Three with no Champion for a bit.
en: HEATHER: Yeah, we were the Elite Three with no Champion for a bit.
ja: ヘザー: うん、しばらくチャンピオンなしの三人四天王だったんだ。

key: But the League is totally different now, except for me.
en: But the League is totally different now, except for me.
ja: でも今のリーグは全然違うよ、あたし以外は。

key: But anyway, you probably both have a lot on your minds, so you should probably talk to the Champion.
en: But anyway, you probably both have a lot on your minds, so you should probably talk to the Champion.
ja: まあでも、二人とも色々考えることあるだろうから、チャンピオンと話した方がいいよ。

key: ELIAS: You replaced \PN?
en: ELIAS: You replaced \PN?
ja: イライアス: \PNの後任がいるのですか?

key: But they weren't even here to--
en: But they weren't even here to--
ja: しかし彼らは、ここにいなかったはず――

key: HEATHER: You should be grateful.
en: HEATHER: You should be grateful.
ja: ヘザー: 感謝したほうがいいよ。

key: She's the one that figured out where you both went.
en: She's the one that figured out where you both went.
ja: 二人がどこに行ったか突き止めたのは彼女なんだから。

key: Before she worked out you had traveled through time, we all thought you both just... vanished.
en: Before she worked out you had traveled through time, we all thought you both just... vanished.
ja: 彼女が時間旅行してるって突き止めるまで、みんな二人ともただ……消えたんだと思ってた。

key: But here you both are, back like she said you would be, eventually.
en: But here you both are, back like she said you would be, eventually.
ja: でも二人ともこうしてここにいる、彼女が言った通り、いつかは戻ってくるって。

key: Although, she was probably so sure because she went and got the Relic Stone herself, to attract Celebi here.
en: Although, she was probably so sure because she went and got the Relic Stone herself, to attract Celebi here.
ja: もっとも、彼女がそんなに確信してたのは、多分自分でわざわざ遺跡の石を取りに行って、セレビィをここに引き寄せたからなんだろうけどね。

key: This is just an entranceway now; we made a whole room for her, just like the Elite Four get.
en: This is just an entranceway now; we made a whole room for her, just like the Elite Four get.
ja: 今はただの入口だよ。四天王と同じように、彼女のために丸ごと一部屋作ったから。

key: ELIAS: She sounds very impressive.
en: ELIAS: She sounds very impressive.
ja: イライアス: 大変立派な方のようですね。

key: ELIAS: So who is it?
en: ELIAS: So who is it?
ja: イライアス: それで、それは誰なのですか?

key: And won on her first try, no less.
en: And won on her first try, no less.
ja: しかも一発目で勝ったというのですから。

key: But I shouldn't keep you.
en: But I shouldn't keep you.
ja: しかし、あなたを引き止めるわけにはいきませんね。

key: She's waiting.
en: She's waiting.
ja: 彼女が待っています。

key: Just head through the door in back to get to her room.
en: Just head through the door in back to get to her room.
ja: 奥のドアを通れば、彼女の部屋に行けます。

key: And... I'll see you two later.
en: And... I'll see you two later.
ja: それでは……また後でお会いしましょう。

key: HEATHER: And... welcome back, \PN.
en: HEATHER: And... welcome back, \PN.
ja: ヘザー: それと……おかえり、\PN。

key: We all really missed you.
en: We all really missed you.
ja: みんな、あんたのことすごく恋しかったんだよ。

key: ELIAS: ...She looks almost exactly like her mother.
en: ELIAS: ...She looks almost exactly like her mother.
ja: イライアス: ……彼女は、母親にそっくりですね。

key: ELIAS: Well, we shouldn't keep this mysterious new Champion waiting.
en: ELIAS: Well, we shouldn't keep this mysterious new Champion waiting.
ja: イライアス: さて、この謎の新チャンピオンを、これ以上待たせるわけにはいきませんね。

key: An unknown challenger is approaching!
en: An unknown challenger is approaching!
ja: 見知らぬ挑戦者が近づいてきた!

key: Fight in Singles or Doubles?
en: Fight in Singles or Doubles?
ja: シングルバトルとダブルバトル、どちらで戦いますか?

key: Singles
en: Singles
ja: シングル

key: Doubles
en: Doubles
ja: ダブル
